name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '17' is the per-event dispatch-table index (idx 0x17 of the table at 0x51B91), a meaningful domain ID, not an address residue. Descriptor corrected from '__unref_turn_gated' to '__ch6_captain_defeat': the slot is LIVE, reached via the ch6 kill-drop path -- ch6 char_spawn_record[0] = the 王國軍 captain (隊長, enemy_data 9 精英戰士, char_id 0x4D; party_member_count 8 so record[0] spawns into runtime slot 8) carries pickup_kind=2 param=0x17, so the captain's death dispatches consequence[0x17]. The body is the captain-defeat cinematic (page 4/5 + royal army disarm + 史恩 removed). The earlier 'unref' verdict only scanned turn-event/tile-step hooks and missed the kill-drop path; the turn-counter gate remains (cinematic plays only before turn 15).
purpose: Chapter 6 captain-defeat cinematic (dispatch slot idx 0x17, reached via the ch6 kill-drop path): when the 王國軍 captain (隊長, record[0] enemy_data 9 精英戰士, pickup_kind=2 param=0x17) falls, it disarms the per-event AI/dialog control flag for chars 0x08..0x1C (the royal army stands down) and shows dialog page 4, then -- only while the battle turn counter is still below turn 15 -- plays a two-cutscene death cinematic (page 5, 史恩's mourning), removes char 0x21 (史恩), and flips the battle-animation phase to 1.
logic_summary: Unconditional head: fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(0x08, 0x1C, 0) zeroes the low 4 bits of combat_aux_block[0xD] across chars 0x08..0x1C (21 chars); fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=4, ...) = 0x08 captain's line. Gate: if ((int32)data_fd2_battle_turn_counter < 0xF) (original CMP [0x53BEF],0xF; JGE signed compare): fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(2); fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(5, 0x11); fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x19); fd2_display_dialog_scene(..., page=5, ...) = 史恩(0x21) mourning + captain's last words; fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(5, 0x11); fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x1A); fd2_mark_char_as_dead(0x21) removes 史恩; data_fd2_battle_anim_phase = 1. No RNG, no numeric computation. In the original binary the if-true tail JMPs into the shared __CHK epilogue at 0x35C18 (MOV [0x51A83],1; RET) and the gate-fail path JGEs to the bare RET at 0x35C22; reproduced in src as the inline store inside the gated block (Layer-2 equivalence).

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Uniform 1-arg cdecl event argument passed by the per-event handler dispatcher (table at 0x51B91; the kill-drop recipient/killer idx). The body never reads it ((void)event_arg in src).
params.reason: Live Ghidra name is already 'event_arg' (not a generic param_N placeholder) and matches the source; it accurately names the uniform dispatch argument. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Effect is the AI-flag disarm across chars 0x08..0x1C + dialog page 4, and, when the turn-counter gate passes, the death cinematic (two cutscenes + dialog page 5 + portrait reload + camera pans), the removal of char 0x21 (史恩), and battle_anim_phase set to 1.
